Add government/opposition columns

Source: R/government.R
parl_add_government.Rd

Adds govern and es_govern to any data frame with a data (date) and a party_data column, using parl_governments(). es_govern is NA when party_data is missing or there is no statutory government in office.

Usage

parl_add_government(data)

Arguments

data

A data frame with columns data and party_data.

Value

data with the columns govern and es_govern added (or replaced).

Examples

x <- data.frame(data = as.Date(c("1933-05-02", "1936-06-03")), party_data = c("LR", "ERC"))
parl_add_government(x)
#>         data party_data           govern es_govern
#> 1 1933-05-02         LR 1933-01 Macià II     FALSE
#> 2 1936-06-03        ERC 1936-05 Companys      TRUE
